title: Poser scene or pose file
description: A file with 'cards' is a SCENE (poses in order, played as a motion); one with 'joints' is a POSE. Angles are degrees from rest (bend, side, twist; Body clamps them to data/body_limits.json on load), positions metres, quaternions [x, y, z, w]. Derived fields (A, G, pos, end, at_limit, contacts, bad_frames, length_s, arrive_s, leave_s) are written for readers and ignored on load. tools/validate.gd checks a file against this; tests/schema_test.gd keeps the enums equal to the code's tables.

grip2.description: Lock both hands: the second hand's grip in the weapon's frame (hand, u = metres up the shaft, lpos, lrot, fingers)

weapon2.description: the off-hand weapon (round 33, dual wield): always held, in the hand the main weapon is not in

move.description: seconds to arrive from the card before; -1 = auto

expr.description: R22: the card's face expression (scripts/face.gd, FACS action units: pain AU4+6/7+9/10+43, effort AU4+7+24, anger AU4+5+7+23, surprise AU1+2+5+26). Absent = neutral; weights blend between cards.

kind.description: the project kind the start screen made it as (only when not animation)

building.description: BUILD: the house record (scripts/build/building.gd, its own version)

audio.description: the sound on the timeline; only when there is one. offset = seconds where it starts

markers.description: named moments on the timeline (round 41); only when any

note.description: ROADMAP 97: free text, several lines (kept to 2000 characters); only when not empty

color.description: ROADMAP 97: the marker's colour (Tok mk_*); absent = its kind's colour

notes.description: review comments on frames (ROADMAP 29, scripts/review.gd); only when any

beats.description: CHOREOGRAPHY (ROADMAP 13, scripts/choreo.gd): the exchange's named moments on the hero's scene; only when any. by / on = fighter numbers (0 = the hero, k = the k-th actor)

actors.description: further characters (two-character scenes, G1); the top level is actor 0. Written only when there is more than one actor

props.description: THE SET (scripts/props.gd): the props placed in the scene (furniture, a house, an imported model, a Part). Props.to_dict writes kind, pos (m), yaw (deg) and the optional fields below; written only when there is one. A kind is a library name, or part:<name>#<hash> for a Part in the set: its record is part_rec, and a load makes the kind again from it (BuildStage.restore_part), so the part is not skipped. Any other kind that is not in this library is skipped on load and said

swing.description: a door's swing, degrees (hinged props only)

keys.description: animated props: t (s), pos, yaw and swing (hinged only)

part_rec.description: a Part in the set (kind part:...): the Part record, Part.to_file (the features; the solid is replayed from them)

body_mesh.description: G07 THE BODY MESH (scripts/body_file.gd): the .kbody the fighter's applied body is saved in, by reference (not embedded: a body is ~1 MB, a scene is autosaved, versioned and diffed); written only when the fighter draws an applied body. file = the .kbody path; sha256 = that file's hash when the scene was saved (a different file still opens, with a note). kbody = the body itself, inline, only in an autosave or journal entry of an applied body that has no file yet (a save always names a file).

kbody.description: a .kbody dict: {format, version, name, params, mesh} (scripts/body_file.gd to_dict)

armour.description: B23 ARMOUR PLATES (scripts/armour_from_body.gd): the plates on the fighter, in the order they were made, each a skinned KMesh (KMesh.to_dict: exact). Written only when there are any; a file without the key has none.

label.description: the anatomy tags or regions the plate covers

name.description: the part's node name on the fighter (armour_<n>)

kmesh.description: KMesh.to_dict(): verts, faces, attributes (the skin:<bone> weights, armour_part, armour_src)

body.description: PROPORTIONS (round 51, scripts/proportions.gd): the body this scene is animated on; written only when not the mannequin as shipped. stature = metres, floor to the top of the head; scale = per segment, multiplies that segment's bones, capsules and mesh (uniformly; missing = 1); sex picks de Leva 1996's mass table; mass = kg; preset = the ANSUR II preset it came from. data/skeleton.json is never edited.

blend.description: the BODY page's woman (0) <-> man (1) blend of the two ANSUR II samples; written only strictly between 0 and 1 (the ends are the sexes); absent = read from sex

bones.description: J01 BONE EDITOR (scripts/bone_editor.gd): the user's extra bones under the UE5 skeleton or each other; only when any. head / tail = metres in the parent's rest frame (its head the origin), roll = degrees about the bone (armature space), connect = the head stays on the parent's tail

ik.description: IK / FK with pole targets (GAP_ANALYSIS row 13): per limb (named by its tip), keys over time; written only when there is one. Each key: t = seconds, target = where the wrist / ankle goes (world, m), pole = a point the elbow / knee bends toward (world, m), w = IK weight 0..1 (linear between keys), rot = the hand / foot world rotation (optional). "spine" = the back's spline IK (scripts/spine_ik.gd): target = the chest control, pole = the mid-back control, twist = [hip, chest] degrees. scripts/limb_ik.gd

asserts.description: BODY ASSERTIONS (INNOVATIONS N002; scripts/body_assert.gd): check lines an agent wrote, like tests ("left foot planted 0-0.4 s", "right fist touches his chin at 0.6 s +-1 f"). Check re-runs them; a failing one is a MUST FIX finding with its miss. Written only when there is one.

plants.description: FOOT PLANTS (ROADMAP 8; scripts/foot_plant.gd): a foot's sole stays where it was at t0 over [t0, t1] (the leg re-solved by LimbIK, the pelvis untouched), eased on and off over 3 frames at the scene's fps. One plant per foot at a time; written only when there is one, in t0 order. Evaluated after the IK pass, before the constraints.

secondary.description: SECONDARY MOTION (ROADMAP 26; scripts/secondary_motion.gd): chains (a ponytail, a cloth strip: a chain of segments hanging from a joint, mass-proportional damping) and rods (a flexible oak bo: one cantilever bending mode). keys = the segments' angles relative to the one before, in degrees about dir x sway, one every 1/120 s (t in seconds; a spline through the keys on replay); fps = the frame rate the attach path was sampled at. Written only when there is an item.

attach.description: a Body joint the item hangs from

off.description: the root's offset in the attach joint's frame, m

drivers.description: USER DRIVERS (GAP_ANALYSIS row 15; scripts/drivers.gd): driven = source * factor + offset, per axis (0 bend, 1 side, 2 twist), in degrees; played after the cards, layers and breathing, before IK and constraints. from = the source counts only above it (max(source - from, 0)). Written only when there is one, in list order.

constraints.description: USER CONSTRAINTS (round 51, CN; scripts/constraints.gd): a stack played in order after IK; written only when there is one. type child_of: owner (a hand, a foot or the pelvis) follows target x offset (the owner in the target's frame, stored when made); track_to: the head aims at the target within the neck's limits; floor: a foot never below height (m). w = influence 0..1, wk = keyed influence [[t, w], ...] (linear between, times w), mute = off.

sets.description: SELECTION SETS and KEYING SETS (GAP_ANALYSIS rows 9, 6): named groups of body parts; written only when there is one. select = name -> parts (a click selects exactly them); keying = name -> parts (with one active, K keys every body part in it at the playhead, one undo step); active = the active keying set's name. Mirror swaps each part to its twin and a name ending _l / _r to the other. scripts/part_sets.gd

camera.description: THE SHOT CAMERA (GAP_ANALYSIS row 21): one keyed camera; written only when there is one. Each key: t = seconds, pos = where the lens is (world, m), aim = the point it looks at (world, m), f = focal length in mm on a 36 mm wide sensor, 16:9 frame (fov_v = 2 atan(20.25 / 2 / f)). Between keys pos, aim and f follow the part keys' monotone curve. scripts/shot_camera.gd

shots.description: THE SHOTS (ROADMAP 75): the cuts of a multi-shot scene, sorted by t; the first at 0. Each shot's camera is a keyed camera (the same keys as camera). Written only when there are shots and they are not the one default shot (that one is written as camera). scripts/shot_camera.gd

clips.description: CLIPS (GAP_ANALYSIS row 12; Blender NLA strips / Maya Time Editor clips): other scene or move files placed by reference as strips; written only when there are any. Strip length = L x repeat / speed (L = the source's length); inside it the source plays at lt = u - k L, u = (t - start) x speed, k = min(floor(u / L), repeat - 1); weight = w x clamp((t - start) / bin) x clamp((end - t) / bout); cycle k's hips moved by k x the cycle's step over the floor. scripts/clips.gd

warp.description: CLIP WARPING (ROADMAP 83): interior knots [x, y] of the strip's time curve, x and y in 0..1, x increasing, y non-decreasing; the ends (0,0) and (1,1) are fixed. Written only when the curve is not linear. scripts/clips.gd warp_*

attrs.description: CUSTOM ATTRIBUTES (ROADMAP 82, scripts/custom_attr.gd): named float values on a part ("<part>.<name>"), keyed per card like a joint angle; min < max, default in range; keys: t = seconds, v = the value. Written only when there is one.

part_keys.description: PART KEYS (round 41, WW1): one joint's own keys over the card blend; written only when there is one. Each key: t = seconds into the scene, v = [bend, side, twist] degrees. scripts/part_keys.gd

interp.description: XX1: how the curve leaves this key toward the next; absent = bezier

handle.description: XX1: this key's bezier handle type; absent = auto_clamped (round 41's curve)

hin.description: [dt, d_bend, d_side, d_twist]: a bezier handle as an offset from its key (XX1)

hout.description: [dt, d_bend, d_side, d_twist]: a bezier handle as an offset from its key (XX1)

inf.description: XX1: on a joint's FIRST key: what the curve does outside its keys; absent = hold

mods.description: DD2: on a joint's FIRST key: a curve modifier stack applied in order on top of the keys (Blender's F-Curve modifiers); the keys are unchanged

offset.description: stepped: seconds; noise (GE4): the noise moved in time, seconds

range_start.description: GE5: Restrict Frame Range, seconds; with range_end, the only times the modifier applies. Absent = everywhere

range_end.description: GE5: Restrict Frame Range, seconds (clamped to >= range_start)

blend_in.description: GE5: seconds over which the influence ramps up from range_start (written only when > 0)

blend_out.description: GE5: seconds over which the influence ramps down to range_end (written only when > 0)
